newsitem.title: ITALY: HORSE RACING-DETTORI WINS ITALIAN OAKS ON NICOLE PHARLY.
newsitem.headline: HORSE RACING-DETTORI WINS ITALIAN OAKS ON NICOLE PHARLY.

text.p: Frankie Dettori rode Nicole Pharly to their second Italian classic victory of the season when they won the Oaks d'Italia on Sunday.
They won the Italian 1,000 Guineas -- the Premio Regina Elena -- last month.
Result of the Oaks d'Italia for three-year-old fillies run over 2.2 kms at San Siro: 1. Nicole Pharly (Frankie Dettori) 2. Attitre (Michael Roberts) 3. Sopran Mariduff (John Reid)
Winner owned by the Scuderia Blu Horse and trained in Italy by Alberto Verdesi.
Tote (to a 10 lira stake): Win 21; places 12 13 18. Dual Forecast: 30.
